requirements.title: Take the findings a rework answers
requirements.rationale: A controller writes this file from a gate's output, a reviewer's comment or a hub's conflict report, and should learn that it is malformed before it starts a session.

criteria.action: for any findings file that is a non-empty JSON array whose entries each hold a non-empty `id`, a `source` that is `gate`, `review`, `person`, `health` or `conflict`, a non-empty `text`, and optionally `file`, `line`, a positive integer given only with `file`, `criterion`, an id of the form `REQ-N.C`, `output` and the boolean `binding`, accept it
criteria.contract: validating the file against the schema returns no error

setup: the schema compiled from specification/schemas/af-impl-findings.v1.json the same way
check.pseudocode: in specification/schemas/af_impl_findings_test.go (new), a table of files the schema accepts: {one finding of each of the five sources with id and text only; a review finding with file 'retry/budget.go' and line 41; a gate finding with output and binding true; a person finding with criterion 'REQ-2.3'; a finding with file and no line; a finding carrying all eight members; a conflict finding beside two review findings}: assert schema.Validate(file) returns no error

criteria.condition: a findings file is not an array, is an empty array, or holds an entry that lacks `id`, `source` or `text`, has an empty `id`, `text` or `file`, a `source` outside the five, a `line` that is not a positive integer or comes without `file`, a `criterion` not of the form `REQ-N.C`, an `output` that is not a string, a `binding` that is not a boolean, or a member the schema does not name
criteria.contract: validating the file returns an error that names the entry and the member that is missing, wrong or unknown

setup: the schema compiled from specification/schemas/af-impl-findings.v1.json the same way
check.pseudocode: in specification/schemas/af_impl_findings_test.go, a table of files the schema refuses, each with what the error must name: {an object in place of the array; []; a finding without id, without source and without text in turn; id ''; text ''; source 'reviewer'; line 41 without file; line 0; line '41'; file ''; criterion 'REQ-2'; binding 'yes'; output given as a list; a finding with an added member 'severity'}: assert schema.Validate(file) returns an error whose text names it

requirements.title: Answer every finding with a reply
requirements.rationale: The reviewer or the person who wrote a finding reads what was done about it, and a controller counts the fixes; a reply without its action or its commit answers neither.

criteria.action: for any result document of the mode `rework` whose `replies` is a non-empty list of entries holding `id`, `action`, one of `fixed`, `declined`, `not_reproduced` and `failed`, and `text`, with `commit` on a `fixed` one and `commit` and `test` on a `not_reproduced` one, accept it
criteria.contract: validating the document returns no error

setup: the schema compiled from specification/schemas/af-impl-result.v1.json by the helper the tests beside it already use

a rework base document built in the test: skill 'af-impl', mode 'rework', outcome 'reworked', the package of the no_merge base document, branch 'work/62', a 40-digit hex head, pushed true, replies holding {id: 'f1', action: 'fixed', text, commit, test: 'TestBudget_CapsTheRetries'}, and empty open_items
check.pseudocode: in specification/schemas/af_impl_result_test.go, in the table of accepted documents, the rework base document with a change: {unchanged; a second reply {id: 'f2', action: 'fixed', text, commit} with no test; a second reply {id: 'f2', action: 'declined', text}; a second reply {id: 'f2', action: 'not_reproduced', text, commit, test}; a declined reply that also carries test}: assert schema.Validate(document) returns no error

criteria.condition: a result document of the mode `rework` that is not a refusal lacks `replies` or holds an empty list, or an entry of `replies` lacks `id`, `action` or `text`, has an empty `id` or `text`, an `action` outside the four, or a member the schema does not name
criteria.contract: validating the document returns an error that names `replies` or the entry's missing or wrong member

setup: the schema compiled from specification/schemas/af-impl-result.v1.json by the helper the tests beside it already use

a rework base document built in the test: skill 'af-impl', mode 'rework', outcome 'reworked', the package of the no_merge base document, branch 'work/62', a 40-digit hex head, pushed true, replies holding {id: 'f1', action: 'fixed', text, commit, test: 'TestBudget_CapsTheRetries'}, and empty open_items
check.pseudocode: in specification/schemas/af_impl_result_test.go, in the table of refused documents, the rework base document with one change, each with the member the error must name: {replies removed; replies []; replies given as an object; a reply without id, without action and without text in turn; id ''; text ''; action 'changed'; action 'done'; the fixed reply without commit; commit ''; a second reply of action 'not_reproduced' without test and without commit in turn; test ''; a reply with an added member 'finding'}: assert schema.Validate(document) returns an error whose text names that member

criteria.condition: a reply's `action` is `fixed` and it has no `commit`, or its `action` is `not_reproduced` and it has no `commit` or no `test`, or its `commit` or `test` is empty
criteria.contract: validating the document returns an error that names `commit` or `test`

requirements.title: Say how a rework ended
requirements.rationale: The controller sends the branch to its gate again, or to a person, by the outcome alone, so an outcome its replies contradict must not pass.

criteria.action: for any result document of a rework that got past its refusals, accept it: `mode` is `rework`, `outcome` is `reworked`, `nothing_changed`, `rework_failed` or `push_failed`, and it holds `package`, `replies` and `open_items`, with no `tasks`, `deviations`, `summary` or `run` required
criteria.contract: validating the document returns no error

setup: the schema compiled from specification/schemas/af-impl-result.v1.json by the helper the tests beside it already use

a rework base document built in the test: skill 'af-impl', mode 'rework', outcome 'reworked', the package of the no_merge base document, branch 'work/62', a 40-digit hex head, pushed true, replies holding {id: 'f1', action: 'fixed', text, commit, test: 'TestBudget_CapsTheRetries'}, and empty open_items
check.pseudocode: in specification/schemas/af_impl_result_test.go, in the table of accepted documents, the rework base document with a change: {open_items holding one untested item of the no_merge shape; outcome 'nothing_changed' with one declined reply and pushed true; outcome 'nothing_changed' with one not_reproduced reply and pushed false; outcome 'rework_failed' with a failed reply beside the fixed one and pushed false; outcome 'rework_failed' with only fixed replies, pushed false and a gate of verdict 'fail'; outcome 'rework_failed' with one failed reply, no gate and pushed true; outcome 'push_failed' with a reason and pushed false; each of refused_findings, refused_open_tasks, refused_branch, refused_dependency, refused_dirty and refused_package with a reason and no package, replies or open_items; refused_open_tasks with a reason and a package}: assert schema.Validate(document) returns no error; and assert the no_merge base document of the existing tables still validates

criteria.condition: a result document of the mode `rework` has the `outcome` `refused_findings`, `refused_open_tasks`, `refused_branch`, `refused_dependency`, `refused_dirty` or `refused_package` and carries a non-empty `reason`
criteria.contract: validating the document returns no error, with or without a `package` member

criteria.condition: a result document's `mode` is `rework` and its `outcome` is none of `reworked`, `nothing_changed`, `rework_failed`, `push_failed`, `refused_findings`, `refused_open_tasks`, `refused_branch`, `refused_dependency`, `refused_dirty` and `refused_package`, or its `mode` is `no_merge` and its `outcome` is `reworked`, `nothing_changed`, `rework_failed`, `refused_findings` or `refused_open_tasks`, or its `mode` is neither of the two
criteria.contract: validating the document returns an error that names `outcome` or `mode`

a rework base document built in the test: skill 'af-impl', mode 'rework', outcome 'reworked', the package of the no_merge base document, branch 'work/62', a 40-digit hex head, pushed true, replies holding {id: 'f1', action: 'fixed', text, commit, test: 'TestBudget_CapsTheRetries'}, and empty open_items
check.pseudocode: in specification/schemas/af_impl_result_test.go, in the table of refused documents, each with the member the error must name: {the rework base with outcome 'complete' -> outcome; with outcome 'parked' and a parked member -> outcome; with outcome 'written' -> outcome; the no_merge base with outcome 'reworked' -> outcome; the no_merge base with outcome 'refused_findings' and a reason -> outcome; the no_merge base with outcome 'refused_open_tasks' and a reason -> outcome; the rework base with mode 'repair' -> mode; with package removed -> package; with open_items removed -> open_items; with outcome 'refused_findings' and no reason -> reason; with outcome 'refused_open_tasks' and reason '' -> reason; with outcome 'push_failed', pushed false and no reason -> reason; with outcome 'push_failed', a reason and pushed true -> pushed; with pushed false -> pushed; with the one reply declined -> replies; with a failed reply beside the fixed one -> replies; outcome 'nothing_changed' with the fixed reply -> replies; outcome 'nothing_changed' with a failed reply -> replies; outcome 'rework_failed' with only the fixed reply and no gate -> gate; outcome 'rework_failed' with only the fixed reply and a gate of verdict 'pass' -> gate}: assert schema.Validate(document) returns an error whose text names that member

criteria.condition: a result document of the mode `rework` has the `outcome` `reworked`, `nothing_changed`, `rework_failed` or `push_failed` and lacks `package` or `open_items`, or has an `outcome` that begins `refused_` or is `push_failed` and no `reason`, or an empty one
criteria.contract: validating the document returns an error that names the missing member

criteria.condition: a result document's `outcome` is `reworked` and no reply is `fixed`, a reply is `failed`, or `pushed` is `false`
criteria.contract: validating the document returns an error that names `replies` or `pushed`

criteria.condition: a result document's `outcome` is `nothing_changed` and a reply is `fixed` or `failed`
criteria.contract: validating the document returns an error that names `replies`

criteria.condition: a result document's `outcome` is `rework_failed` and it holds neither a `failed` reply nor a `gate` whose `verdict` is `fail` or `not_run`, or its `mode` is `rework`, its `outcome` is `push_failed` and its `pushed` is `true`
criteria.contract: validating the document returns an error that names `gate`, `replies` or `pushed`
